As a Christian hybrid microschool, it requires on-campus attendance two days per week while the remaining coursework is completed at home with parental oversight. The curriculum emphasizes a Biblical worldview and integrates classical education principles. Core subjects include reading, writing, mathematics, critical thinking, and character formation within a screen-free environment.

founder.name: Marta Mac
founder.bio: Marta MacBan, a Phoenix native with a bachelor’s degree in mass communication and Spanish from Arizona State University, founded Sonoran Learning Collective. Her background includes developing a cottage school and advocating for school choice through local nonprofit work.

schools.name: The Attuned Community School
schools.description: The Attuned Community School in Centerville, Georgia, serves students from kindergarten through eighth grade. The program distinguishes itself by integrating play-based and nature-based learning with project- and inquiry-based approaches. Students spend over ninety minutes daily outdoors engaging in gardening, hiking, and scavenger hunts to foster environmental stewardship. This model emphasizes critical thinking, problem-solving, and holistic growth, allowing learners to explore real-world issues while developing self-regulation and emotional processing skills within a collaborative community setting.

founder.name: Latoya Nelson
founder.bio: Latoya Nelson founded The Attuned Community School in Centerville, GA. A Philadelphia native with three degrees and ten years of K-12 experience, she previously served as a preschool director and community schools advisor, specializing in trauma-informed education.

schools.name: Mirus Academy
schools.description: Located in Katy, Texas, Mirus Academy serves students in grades 8 through 12. Established in 2014, this microschool maintains an enrollment of approximately 25 to 30 students supported by five faculty members. The institution functions as a hybrid model between traditional schooling and homeschooling, focusing on college-preparatory academics within a small-group educational setting.

schools.name: Endeavor Academy
schools.description: Endeavor Academy is a microschool located in Mesa, Arizona, serving students across various grade levels. The institution distinguishes itself through small class sizes designed to provide individualized attention and support for learners of all abilities. This structure aims to foster a close-knit community environment while delivering focused academic instruction tailored to the specific needs of each student within the program.

schools.name: Legacy Builders Academy
schools.description: Legacy Builders Academy is a faith-based microschool located in Gardendale, Alabama, serving students in grades 5 through 10. The institution emphasizes child-led learning and individualized education plans to support personalized academic growth. It prioritizes active parent involvement and community engagement to create a supportive environment that nurtures each student's unique potential while maintaining equitable access to tailored educational resources.

founder.name: Yalonda Chandler
founder.bio: Yalonda Chandler, a former teacher with over a decade of experience, co-founded Legacy Builders Academy and serves as its executive director. She also co-founded Black Homeschoolers of Birmingham, leveraging her extensive homeschooling background to support neurodivergent students and the broader community.

schools.name: Riverside Academy Educational Services
schools.description: Riverside Academy Educational Services operates a microschool in Brookville, Franklin County, Indiana, serving students in grades K-6. The program emphasizes small class sizes and personalized instruction within a self-directed learning environment. Scholars engage with customized learning plans tailored to their individual pace and current academic level. This approach prioritizes student choice and voice, aiming to develop critical thinking, creativity, and essential skills through an individualized educational framework.

founder.name: Ashley Brodbeck
founder.bio: Ashley Brodbeck founded Riverside Educational Services in Indiana in 2023. She holds bachelor’s and master’s degrees in education from Northern Kentucky University and Brandman University, with ten years of teaching experience across Ohio, Indiana, and California.

schools.name: Rocky Stars Community Campus
schools.description: Rocky Stars Community Campus in Rocky Ford serves grades K through 12 as a tuition-free microschool utilizing mastery and project-based learning. The institution emphasizes student autonomy, offering tailored instruction in mathematics and English alongside inquiry-led explorations of civics, history, sciences, and arts. Students develop practical life skills, including financial literacy and emotional regulation, while engaging in self-guided projects that foster initiative and responsibility within a small-class setting.

schools.name: Star Lab
schools.description: Star Lab is a Montessori-inspired microschool in Sarasota, Florida, serving students from Pre-K through 4th grade. Located in historic Newtown, the institution emphasizes individualized learning plans, daily arts integration, and frequent movement breaks to support holistic development. The school offers healthy meals, weekly parent conferences, and monthly academic showcases to track student progress. It accepts Step Up scholarships for eligible families seeking a personalized elementary education environment.

founder.name: Alison Rini
founder.bio: Alison Rini, a teacher and school leader with over 20 years of experience, holds three Columbia University degrees in Neuroscience, Curriculum, and School Leadership. She founded Star Lab, a Newtown microschool serving K-3 students, to apply research-based practices from diverse educational models.

schools.name: Ember Academy
schools.description: Ember Academy is a microschool in Ocala, Florida, serving students in grades 1 through 9. The institution offers part-time and full-time programs featuring small group instruction, one-on-one tutoring, and discovery-based learning. Daily routines begin with whole-group readings of classic novels to set monthly themes, followed by thematic activities designed to develop critical thinking and metacognition. The curriculum integrates language arts and mathematics based on individual student needs alongside botany, physical fitness, and mindfulness exercises.

founder.name: Meghan Pace
founder.bio: Meghan Pace-King founded Ember Academy. With ten years as a teacher, tutor, and specialist, she holds a Western Governors University degree and Florida certifications in birth-5, K-6, K-12 ESE, reading, and ESOL. Her three children inspired her constructivist approach to education.

schools.name: A Fuller Education
schools.description: A Fuller Education is a microschool in Bethel Township, Pennsylvania, serving students from Pre-K through second grade. The program offers flexible attendance options of two, three, or five days per week, with sessions running from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Designed for children aged three to seven, the school integrates a Christ-centered curriculum within a small learning community environment.

founder.name: Joanna
founder.bio: Joanna founded A Fuller Education. She taught in Los Angeles and El Salvador, then coached K-12 educators for ten years. Joanna holds a BA from Biola University and an MEd from Teachers College at Columbia University.

schools.name: Inspire Academy of Schools
schools.description: Inspire Academy of Schools is a microschool located in Sun City, Arizona, serving students from kindergarten through twelfth grade. The institution emphasizes progressive education focused on inclusion, social and emotional learning, entrepreneurship, and community engagement. It provides tailored programs designed to support diverse learners, including those with learning differences, within a specialized academic environment.

founder.name: Irishia Williams
founder.bio: Irishia Williams founded Inspire Academy of Schools in Sun City, AZ. An education consultant and special education specialist, she focuses on personalized learning, social-emotional development, and supporting neurodiverse students and their families.

schools.name: Desert Dragon School
schools.description: Desert Dragon School is a microschool located in Tucson, Arizona, serving students in grades six through eight. The institution specializes in supporting learners with learning differences by offering personalized education within a small, flexible environment. Its distinct approach emphasizes student autonomy and project-based learning, allowing pupils to tailor their academic progress toward specific present and future goals in a comfortable setting.

schools.name: Apogee Dripping Springs
schools.description: Apogee Dripping Springs serves students in grades 9-12 within Dripping Springs, Texas. This microschool combines rigorous academics with practical life skills, including financial literacy and emotional intelligence. The curriculum emphasizes critical thinking and community engagement to prepare teens for real-world challenges. Additionally, enrollment automatically includes adult mentorship programs hosted by the Apogee Strong Foundation, supporting families through structured guidance alongside student education.

founder.name: Sarah
founder.bio: Sarah founded Apogee Dripping Springs. With over twenty years of leadership experience, she holds extensive Waldorf training and previously served as Admissions Director at Charlottesville Waldorf School.

schools.name: A Home for School
schools.description: A Home For School is a microschool located in Moncks Corner, South Carolina, serving students from kindergarten through eighth grade. The institution utilizes a self-paced educational model designed to honor the unique cultural backgrounds of its student body. This approach prioritizes individual learning rhythms and fosters a supportive atmosphere where learners progress at their own speed within a community-focused environment.

founder.name: Isis Spann
founder.bio: Isis Spann, a first-generation college graduate with a master’s from Grand Canyon University and a doctorate in progress, founded A Home for School. She previously taught elementary education in South Carolina for twelve years and serves as CEO of FUNdamentals of Learning, LLC.

schools.name: Creative Minds Microschool
schools.description: Creative Minds Microschool in Wake County, North Carolina, serves students from Kindergarten through eighth grade. The institution utilizes a personalized learning model within a small group environment. Curriculum is tailored to individual student needs, incorporating project-based activities and specialized instruction. This approach aims to foster independent study habits and creative problem-solving skills among its diverse student body.

founder.name: Dr. Lisa
founder.bio: Dr. Lisa Swinson founded Creative Minds Microschool. A National Board Certified teacher with 27 years of experience, she served as a curriculum director, principal, and state education consultant before establishing the school.

schools.name: Societas Draconis
schools.description: Societas Draconis is a microschool in Yuma, Arizona, serving unspecified grades through individualized instruction tailored to each student’s needs. The program emphasizes cultivating innate curiosity and logical reasoning abilities, allowing learners to progress at their own pace while receiving content support suited to their specific educational requirements.

schools.name: Wild Hearts Adventure Co
schools.description: Wild Hearts Adventure Co. serves students in grades 4 through 12 in Visalia, California, meeting twice weekly for project-based learning and core skill development. The program utilizes educational platforms like Miacademy and Curiosity Chronicles to support personalized instruction in math, ELA, science, and social studies. A distinct feature is its Quest system, where learners earn badges to showcase achievements across guided and self-directed activities focused on autonomy and individual strengths.

schools.name: Lucas Literacy Lab
schools.description: Lucas Literacy Lab is a Christian microschool in Old Bridge Township, New Jersey, serving grades 1 through 6. The program integrates literacy with hands-on passion projects and child-led collaborative pursuits within a flexible hybrid learning environment. It supports homeschooling families by allowing integration of external curricula while offering full-time students a project-driven approach focused on reading, writing, speaking, and listening skills.

founder.name: Amanda Lucas
founder.bio: Amanda Lucas founded Lucas Literacy Lab in Old Bridge, NJ. A teacher since 2015 with a BA from Hunter College and Columbia University’s master’s program in elementary inclusive education, she previously worked as an editorial assistant for Parents and American Baby magazines.

schools.name: Academy of Creatives
schools.description: The Academy of Creatives is a microschool located in Columbus, Georgia, serving students from kindergarten through ninth grade. The institution offers a STEAM-based homeschool learning center focused on hands-on educational methods. It distinguishes itself by providing an alternative academic environment that caters to specific learner needs outside traditional classroom settings for families seeking varied instructional approaches.

founder.name: Christina Jones
founder.bio: Christina Jones, holding a BA in sociology and an MA in counseling psychology, founded the Academy of Creatives in Columbus, GA. She directs the microschool, leveraging her background in homeschooling to support learning pods and provide resources for foster children.

schools.name: Alectrix Preparatory
schools.description: Alectrix Preparatory serves students in grades K through 12th grade in Lawrenceville, Georgia. The school employs an inquiry-based, mastery-focused curriculum designed for diverse learners, including those with mild processing or attention differences. Small group instruction and individualized learning plans support foundational skill development alongside social-emotional growth. This approach emphasizes critical thinking and real-world application to foster student independence and confidence within a supportive academic community.

founder.bio: RJ Collins founded Alectrix Preparatory in Los Angeles. He holds a bachelor’s degree from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, and has eight years of experience as a tutor, teacher for neurodivergent students, and elementary special education teacher.

schools.name: Praxis Elite Sports Academy Junior Prep
schools.description: Praxis Elite Sports Academy Junior Prep is a microschool located in San Diego County, California, serving students in grades 6 through 8. The institution provides a curated academic environment specifically designed for student athletes, integrating academics and athletics equally within its specialized curriculum. Additionally, the school offers an eighth-grade gap year program for students seeking to delay high school entry by one year.

schools.name: The Lab School of Memphis
schools.description: The Lab School of Memphis serves students in grades K-8 within Memphis, Tennessee. This microschool offers a personalized curriculum designed to integrate real-world experiences into daily learning. The program focuses on developing practical skills through hands-on activities and community engagement, providing an educational environment that emphasizes applied knowledge alongside traditional academic instruction for its young learners.

schools.name: Sphinx Academy
schools.description: Sphinx Academy in Lexington, Kentucky, serves students across unspecified grades through a customized microschool model. The institution distinguishes itself by providing individualized educational pathways tailored to specific goals, offering tracks that range from college preparation to career and trade certifications. This approach allows each student to design a unique route to success based on their personal academic and professional needs.

schools.name: Spyrja Academy
schools.description: Spyrja Academy serves students in grades six through twelve within New Braunfels, Texas. The institution emphasizes interdisciplinary learning by connecting content areas to address real-world problems and community service projects. This approach integrates academic instruction with a focus on belonging and purpose-driven education. Additionally, the school plans to expand its operations to Dallas, with a new location scheduled to open in 2027.

founder.name: Jourdan Simmang
founder.bio: Jourdan Simmang is the director of Spyrja Academy, a New Braunfels microschool. He brings fifteen years of Texas teaching experience, having served as a teacher, curriculum writer, department head, and assistant principal.

schools.name: Inner Fire Academy
schools.description: Inner Fire Academy in San Francisco serves gifted learners from kindergarten through fifth grade. The microschool caps each class at eight students to facilitate individualized instruction tailored to specific abilities and interests. This approach allows students to progress based on capability rather than age or grade level. Beyond a customized core curriculum, the school offers specialized electives including coding, Mandarin, chess, and meditation practice for its enrolled cohort.

founder.name: Sebastian Predescu
founder.bio: Sebastian Predescu founded Inner Fire Academy in San Francisco after a 12-year business and technology career. A Harvard economics graduate and former Romanian-Canadian national chess champion, he began substitute teaching in the Bay Area in 2022 before launching his microschool.

schools.name: North Star Teens: Self-Directed Learning
schools.description: North Star Teens: Self-Directed Learning in Sunderland, Massachusetts serves students in sixth through twelfth grade. Operating since 1996, this hybrid program blends homeschooling and traditional schooling elements without awarding diplomas, credits, or grades. The model emphasizes self-directed learning, offering classes, tutorials, advisories, and a social community to support teens pursuing individual academic paths at their own pace.

schools.name: Freedom Preparatory
schools.description: Freedom Preparatory in Wichita, Kansas, serves students from kindergarten through twelfth grade. The school distinguishes itself by allowing learners to progress at individual paces rather than adhering strictly to age-based grade levels. Instruction utilizes living books and hands-on experiences to address holistic development. Math classes are organized based on student needs, enabling customized advancement. The curriculum is fundamentally built upon Christian principles, offering a tailored educational approach for each child.

schools.name: Colossal Academy
schools.description: Located in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, the Colossal Academy serves students in grades 6 through 10. This microschool offers an alternative curriculum that integrates practical life skills such as surfing, skateboarding, cooking, and farming into its educational framework. The program focuses on real-world learning experiences designed to complement traditional academic instruction for its specific grade range.

schools.name: Path of Life Learning
schools.description: Path of Life Learning is a faith-based microschool in Yorktown, Virginia, serving students in grades K-6. The program offers flexible and personalized instruction that emphasizes collaborative learning environments. Curriculum design focuses on engaging educational experiences that extend beyond traditional classroom settings, aiming to develop practical skills and foster student safety and connection through joyful learning activities.

founder.name: Mercedes
founder.bio: Mercedes, founder of Path of Life Learning, holds a master’s degree in education and has nine years of elementary teaching experience. A military spouse, she launched her microschool in the summer of 2022 after careers in rural Kentucky and middle schools nationwide.

schools.name: Canton Learning Collaborative
schools.description: Canton Learning Collaborative operates as a Self-Directed Learning Center in Canton, Illinois, serving students in grades six through twelve. The school utilizes homeschooling law to support young people in transitioning from traditional schooling while helping existing homeschoolers sustain their educational approaches. This microschool offers a distinct self-directed learning model for families in the area seeking alternative educational pathways outside conventional classroom structures.

schools.name: Wellspring Preparatory School
schools.description: Wellspring Preparatory School serves students in grades K through 5th Grade in Monroe, North Carolina. As Union County’s first faith-based STEM microschool, it emphasizes academic rigor within a religious framework. The institution is founded by a National Board Certified Teacher with over thirty years of elementary education experience. Its distinct approach combines science, technology, engineering, and mathematics instruction with character development to provide an intimate learning environment for young learners.

founder.name: Stephanie Van
founder.bio: Stephanie Van Horn is a National Board Certified Teacher (three times) with over 31 years of classroom experience. She founded Wellspring Preparatory School, Union County’s first microschool, to provide personalized academic and spiritual support for students overlooked by traditional systems.

schools.name: Heartwise Scholars Microschool
schools.description: Heartwise Scholars Microschool, located in Chesapeake, Virginia, serves students in grades PreK-5. The program focuses on developing socially motivated scholars who prioritize self-care and community stewardship. It specifically targets the needs of working families by offering an educational environment designed to support the development of whole children within a supportive network.

founder.name: Dr. Crystal
founder.bio: Dr. Crystal Goins founded Heartwise Scholars Microschool in Chesapeake, VA. An experienced educator and entrepreneur behind The Resilient Teacher Mom LLC, she applies her expertise in social-emotional learning and restorative practices to serve Pre-K3 through 8th-grade students.

schools.name: Harmony Homeschool Academy
schools.description: Harmony Homeschool Academy serves students in grades six through twelve in Cary, North Carolina. This secular hybrid institution combines independent study with community-based learning for families in the Raleigh-Durham-Cary region. The school emphasizes core academics and elective courses while prioritizing social interaction and mental well-being. Its model moves beyond traditional classroom structures to offer a flexible educational environment tailored to middle and high school needs.

founder.bio: The founder of Harmony Homeschool Academy is a current high school principal and former charter school founding principal. Now residing on a mini farm outside Nashville, she provides inclusive educational choices for families in Rutherford County, TN.

schools.name: Wellbright School
schools.description: Wellbright School is a microschool located in Martinsburg, West Virginia, serving students in grades 2 through 9. The institution distinguishes itself by bridging theoretical knowledge with practical application through comprehensive vocational training and the instillation of practical life skills. Alongside maintaining high academic standards, the school prioritizes character development and the mental and emotional wellbeing of its students to prepare them for diverse life aspects.

founder.name: Katerina Belik
founder.bio: Katerina Belik founded Wellbright School. She holds a PhD and possesses certifications in ELA, special education, school counseling, and administration. Her background includes twenty-eight years of teaching experience, leading ELA departments to historic academic highs before launching Vedara.

schools.name: Bloom Learning Community
schools.description: Bloom Learning Community operates as a hybrid microschool for students in grades K through 5th Grade in Westlake, Ohio. Situated in the Greater Cleveland area, the institution provides an educational model designed around learner-centered principles. This setup caters specifically to local families seeking alternative schooling options that blend remote and in-person instruction within the community.

schools.name: Stella Maris Collaborative
schools.description: Stella Maris Collaborative serves students in grades four through eight within Northwest Austin, Texas. This Catholic microschool utilizes an integrative curriculum focused on personalized instruction in mathematics and English Language Arts. Distinctive features include low student-to-teacher ratios, multi-age classrooms, and project-based learning opportunities. The school emphasizes community-based service and fosters a faith-centered environment to support individualized educational needs for the whole child.

schools.name: Beacon of Hope Academy
schools.description: Beacon of Hope Academy is a microschool in Greenacres, Florida, serving students from kindergarten through fifth grade. The institution provides specialized, faith-based education tailored for learners with support needs. Its distinct approach integrates individualized academic instruction with therapeutic services to foster an inclusive environment focused on holistic student development across academic, spiritual, and emotional domains.

founder.name: Cassandra
founder.bio: Cassandra founded Beacon of Hope Academy, a faith-based microschool for K-5 students with special needs. A Palm Beach Atlantic University alumna and certified special education teacher with public and private school experience, she is currently pursuing a master’s degree in Special Education through Liberty University Online.

schools.name: RISE Learning Studio
schools.description: Located in Lithia, Florida, RISE Learning Studio serves students from kindergarten through twelfth grade. The institution operates as a hybrid microschool offering specialized programs for lower primary, upper primary, middle grades, and high school support, alongside part-time homeschool enrichment services. It distinguishes itself by prioritizing individual learning plans to address diverse educational needs, while also providing homeschool assessments and portfolio reviews.

founder.name: Melissa Palmer
founder.bio: Melissa Palmer founded RISE Learning Studio. A Tampa native, she holds a USF bachelor’s degree and a Saint Leo University Master’s in Education. Her background includes roles as a classroom teacher, interventionist, special education coordinator, and instructional coach.

schools.name: Uncharted Academy
schools.description: Uncharted Academy in Orange Park, Florida, serves students from kindergarten through twelfth grade as a nonprofit microschool and resource hub. Founded by veterans and educators, the institution specializes in supporting learners with dyslexia, ADHD, ASD, and 2E profiles. It offers flexible full-time, part-time, and hybrid programs alongside tutoring services. Distinctive features include Orton-Gillingham reading intervention, project-based learning, robotics, art, and a sensory-inclusive quiet room for social-emotional support.

schools.name: Saint Louis Sudbury School
schools.description: Saint Louis Sudbury School is located in St. Louis, Missouri, serving students across all grade levels through self-directed education. The institution operates under a democratic governance model where youth and adults share equal authority over school operations. By eliminating mandatory curricula, homework, grades, and standardized testing, the school provides an environment focused on personal interest exploration and community development rather than traditional academic metrics.

schools.name: Arise Microschool
schools.description: Arise Microschool serves students in grades K through 8th Grade within Topeka, Kansas. This institution operates as a small-group learning environment focused on empowering learners through individualized guidance. The school fosters a supportive community structure designed to accommodate diverse educational needs for families seeking alternative schooling options in the local area.

schools.name: Discovery Learners' Academy
schools.description: Discovery Learners' Academy is a microschool located in Chattanooga, Tennessee, serving students from PreK3 through 12th grade. The institution focuses on fostering critical thinking and creative problem-solving skills within its curriculum. It operates as a learning community designed to support diverse educational needs for families in the Chattanooga area seeking alternative schooling options.

schools.name: KnowledgeNest MicroSchool
schools.description: KnowledgeNest MicroSchool in Owasso, Oklahoma, serves students from PreK through fifth grade. The institution emphasizes a trauma-informed approach within a safe environment that prioritizes both nature and nurture. It provides a community setting designed for learners to grow individually. Families seeking educational options near Owasso may consider this microschool for its focus on personalized development and supportive learning conditions.

schools.name: South Tampa Microschool
schools.description: South Tampa Microschool in Tampa, Florida, serves students through a microschool model characterized by small class sizes and qualified instructors. The program emphasizes a creative and imaginative learning environment that prioritizes problem-solving skills. By partnering with families and community members, the school offers an engaging educational approach tailored to individual needs within the local area.

schools.name: Mysa School
schools.description: Located in Washington, District of Columbia, Mysa School serves students from kindergarten through eighth grade as an early pioneer of the microschool model. The institution distinguishes itself through customized learning plans known as 'Mysa Menus,' which allow educators to tailor instruction to individual student needs. This approach prioritizes personalized education and student autonomy in determining how material is learned.

schools.name: Revise Collective
schools.description: Revise Collective is a microschool located in Edmond, Oklahoma, serving students in grades 3 through 12. Operating as a one-room schoolhouse, the institution offers both full-time and virtual schooling options. The program also provides public after-school services, including tutoring, homework assistance, and STEAM enrichment activities to support broader community educational needs.

schools.name: Dessalines S.T.E.A.M Academy
schools.description: Dessalines S.T.E.A.M Academy is a microschool located in Brockton, Massachusetts, serving students across various grade levels. The institution distinguishes itself by offering personalized, culturally affirming, and STEAM-immersive educational experiences tailored to the greater Brockton community. Families can choose between hybrid or full-time enrollment options. This flexible model aims to meet diverse family needs through a specialized curriculum focused on science, technology, engineering, arts, and mathematics within a supportive learning environment.

schools.name: AMPed Hybrid Academy
schools.description: AMPed Hybrid Academy serves students from PreK through eighth grade in Farmington Hills, Michigan. This microschool caters to learners who may not fit into traditional educational settings, including those who are advanced for their grade level or neurodivergent. The institution provides a supportive environment designed to address specific academic and social needs that standard schools might overlook.

schools.name: The Pelican School
schools.description: The Pelican School is an in-home microschool located in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, serving students from kindergarten through second grade. The program emphasizes teamwork, humility, and stewardship within its curriculum. Its distinct approach focuses on cultivating appreciation for creative design while fostering a collaborative learning environment tailored to early elementary education needs.

schools.name: Permission to Succeed Microschool
schools.description: Permission to Succeed Microschool operates in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, offering non-traditional instruction for students across various grade levels. The school utilizes a tutor-style approach focused on mastery learning rather than traditional classroom structures. Its curriculum distinguishes itself by integrating enrichment opportunities in STEAM activities alongside practical lessons in financial literacy and entrepreneurship, providing a specialized educational experience for its community.

schools.name: Wild Haven Microschool
schools.description: Wild Haven Microschool in Burnsville, Minnesota, serves Kindergarten through fifth-grade students. The institution integrates nature-based and homeschool methodologies with Christian curriculum, weaving biblical learning into daily instruction. Its distinct approach features multi-age classrooms that utilize both indoor and outdoor environments for student engagement and educational activities within the local community.

schools.name: Forward Leap
schools.description: Forward Leap is a microschool located in Rochester, Minnesota, serving students from kindergarten through second grade. The institution operates as an inclusive learning community specifically designed for children aged four to eight. It provides educational services tailored to the developmental needs of early learners within this specific geographic area.

schools.name: Wisdom Warehouse
schools.description: Wisdom Warehouse is a microschool located in Coral Gables, Florida, serving students across various grade levels. The institution distinguishes itself by offering both part-time and full-time individualized schooling programs. Its educational approach emphasizes hands-on curriculum and creative learning methods designed to bring academic standards and practical skills to life for each student.

schools.name: Nature's Schoolhouse Microschool
schools.description: Nature's Schoolhouse Microschool in Cedar Park, Texas, serves students from PreK through fifth grade in an intentionally small private setting. The curriculum integrates academic instruction with outdoor experiences to foster creativity and critical thinking. This approach emphasizes a low-stress environment where learners spend significant time exploring the natural world, distinguishing the school through its focus on connecting education with nature rather than traditional classroom structures.

schools.name: ReWild Family Academy
schools.description: ReWild Family Academy is a microschool located in Abbyville, Kansas, serving students in grades K through 8. Housed in a renovated one-hundred-year-old church building, the institution blends nature-based learning with individualized educational paths for children ages five to thirteen. The program emphasizes collaborative projects and fosters an appreciation for creation within its Reno County community setting.

schools.name: AHB Community School
schools.description: AHB Community School serves students in grades K through 8th grade in Austin, Texas. The institution emphasizes high academic expectations within a flexible and nurturing environment. Instruction focuses on meaningful work delivered at an individualized pace suitable for each student. The school fosters a collaborative learning atmosphere that encourages interaction among peers while maintaining rigorous educational standards for its community.

schools.name: The Kineo School
schools.description: The Kineo School is a kindergarten through fifth-grade microschool located in Kirkland, Washington, serving neurodivergent students including those who are autistic or have ADHD. The program distinguishes itself by providing a dedicated sensory room and allowing students to take breaks as needed. Therapists are invited to work within the classroom, facilitating close collaboration with parents to build a comprehensive support team for each student’s individual requirements.

schools.name: Highlands Micro School
schools.description: Highlands Micro School is an independent educational institution located in Northwest Denver, Colorado, serving students from kindergarten through fifth grade. The school utilizes a progressive approach characterized by small class sizes and student-centered learning methodologies. Its curriculum emphasizes inquiry-based instruction designed to foster problem-solving abilities and social development among its enrolled population.

schools.name: Hedge School Cooperative
schools.description: The Hedge School Cooperative in Dripping Springs, Texas, serves students in grades 9 through 12 as an inclusive, secular homeschool cooperative. The institution emphasizes a communal learning environment designed to cultivate compassionate critical thinking and creative skills. This microschool focuses on reimagining traditional educational models to foster a lasting commitment to learning among its adolescent student body within the local community.

schools.name: The Ferguson School
schools.description: The Ferguson School is a microschool located in Decatur, Georgia, serving students from Kindergarten through Fifth Grade. The institution emphasizes culturally inclusive education designed to nurture creativity, foster collaboration, and encourage critical thinking. A distinct feature of its curriculum is the integration of Christian faith, aiming to instill deep religious values alongside academic development for its diverse student body.

schools.name: FreeStyle Learning Center Microschool
schools.description: FreeStyle Learning Center Microschool in Country Club Hills, Illinois, serves students from kindergarten through twelfth grade. The program emphasizes individualized pacing to accommodate diverse learning speeds and priorities. It integrates social-emotional development and self-esteem building into its core curriculum. This approach targets the holistic growth of each student within a flexible educational framework designed for families in Cook County.

schools.name: Vida Academy
schools.description: Vida Academy is a bilingual microschool located in Henrico, Virginia, serving students from PreK through 3rd grade (ages 4–9). The program immerses children in both English and Spanish to build academic foundations while fostering early bilingualism. Classes are small and supportive, integrating social-emotional learning with cultural awareness. Additionally, the curriculum emphasizes nature-based education, providing regular opportunities for outdoor exploration and hands-on science experiences for all enrolled students.

founder.name: Hi
founder.bio: Amanda Simmons-Polanco, founder of Vida Academy, brings nearly 15 years of educational experience. She previously taught in New York City and served as founding principal at a Manhattan elementary school, leveraging her background as a bilingual English-Spanish speaker to support personalized learning environments.

schools.name: Heart Learning Collective
schools.description: Heart Learning Collective is a microschool located in White Bear Lake, Minnesota, serving students from Kindergarten through fifth grade. The institution distinguishes itself through individualized instruction within small class sizes, emphasizing project-based learning to develop critical thinking. Students engage in hands-on activities designed to encourage exploration and self-expression, fostering an environment that prioritizes creative skill development alongside academic growth for young learners.

founder.name: Kathleen Amstutz
founder.bio: Kathleen Amstutz is a co-founder of Heart Learning Collective with 16 years of public school teaching experience. She collaborates with co-founder Tamara Morett, who brings 27 years of district education background and eight years of K-5 special education co-teaching expertise.

schools.name: Res Novae Academy
schools.description: Res Novae Academy is a microschool located in Pinson, Alabama. The institution utilizes project and inquiry-based learning methodologies to foster core academic skills within a mixed-age group environment. This structural approach distinguishes the school by emphasizing collaborative, student-driven instruction rather than traditional grade-level segregation, catering to families seeking an alternative educational model focused on foundational competencies through interactive study.

schools.name: Weehawken Homeschool Collective
