schools.name: Villagers Microschool
schools.description: Villagers Microschool serves first through fifth graders in Austin, Texas. The curriculum emphasizes core academics alongside practical life skills, including time management, public speaking, and technology literacy. Students engage in traditional subjects like reading and math while developing critical thinking and communication abilities. The program supports personal projects and business ideas through individual mentoring. Flexible enrollment options allow families to integrate real-world learning experiences into the standard school day for a comprehensive educational approach.

founder.name: Meredith Orf
founder.bio: Meredith Orf founded Villagers Microschool. A Southwestern University summa cum laude graduate with a BA in Music and English, she previously tutored, taught through Teach For America, and ran a piano studio before launching this educational venture.

schools.name: Grace Academy and Tutoring
schools.description: Grace Academy and Tutoring serves students in grades six through twelve in Bay City, Texas. This faith-based, accredited private micro school offers a Christ-centered educational environment alongside a strong STEM-oriented curriculum. The institution utilizes small learning groups and individualized instruction tailored to each student’s specific strengths and goals. This approach aims to support academic development while fostering character, integrity, and critical thinking skills within a personalized setting.

founder.name: My
founder.bio: Christie Meyerdirk founded Grace Academy and Tutoring, a STEM school designed to foster curiosity and critical thinking. Her entrepreneurial background drives her mission to create an engaging learning environment where students explore science and technology while building confidence and problem-solving skills.

schools.name: Cox Legacy
schools.description: Cox Legacy operates as a microschool in Midlothian, Texas, serving students from kindergarten through fifth grade. Founded by an educator and mother, the institution provides a flexible educational alternative to traditional schooling. The program utilizes a student-centered approach within a structured environment, focusing on individualized support to help children explore subjects actively and develop confidence alongside their academic growth.

founder.name: Welcome
founder.bio: Eleanor Cox is a former teacher and mother of five who founded Cox Legacy in Midlothian for grades K–5, drawing on her educational background to create a personalized learning environment.

schools.name: Seed & Bloom Learning Hub, LLC
schools.description: Seed & Bloom Learning Hub, LLC in Saint Cloud, Florida, serves PreK through fifth-grade students with faith-based educational programming. The microschool utilizes small-group, hands-on instruction to provide a structured environment that supports individualized learning. It partners with families to complement homeschooling and alternative education models for elementary-aged children.

founder.name: Seed
founder.bio: Elizabeth Baker and Brooke Walther founded Seed & Bloom Learning Hub, LLC. As elementary educators with over 30 years of combined experience teaching grades Pre-K through fifth grade, they offer small-group, faith-based instruction.

schools.name: The Legacy & Leadership Collective
schools.description: The Legacy & Leadership Collective operates as a fully online private microschool serving grades PreK through 12th in Texas. Students follow personalized learning paths tailored to individual strengths and pace, with parents actively selecting curriculum resources within a centralized digital hub. The program accommodates varied instructional preferences, ranging from traditional book-based methods to technology-integrated approaches. Additionally, the school facilitates annual virtual World Tours for global perspective building and hosts yearly nationwide gatherings to foster community connections among its dispersed student body.

founder.name: The
founder.bio: The founder of Legacy & Leadership Collective is a mother of five, certified Birth Educator and Doula through Birth Boot Camp, and creator of the nonprofit Parenthood Support.

schools.name: Aya Akoma Academy
schools.description: Aya Akoma Academy is a microschool serving grades six through twelve in Decatur County, Georgia, opening in August 2026. The institution emphasizes culturally responsive instruction grounded in Afrocentric perspectives, focusing on endurance and patience. It provides individualized math support and collaborative learning within small class settings. This approach aims to develop critical thinking and real-world problem-solving skills while fostering student identity and academic confidence.

founder.name: Bethaney Wright
founder.bio: Bethaney Wright founded Aya Akoma Academy. She is a former sixth-grade math teacher and SAT instructor holding a Master of Arts in Education with a focus on mathematics and social studies.

schools.name: The Lion Mountain Academy
schools.description: The Lion Mountain Academy serves sixth-grade students in Knoxville, Tennessee. It employs a Hybrid 4+1 model, combining doctoral inquiry and functional fitness with community service and civic engagement on Fridays. The curriculum emphasizes leadership and independent thinking through Socratic inquiry and economic logic within a low-distraction environment. Students maintain connections to their neighborhoods by participating in local sports, band, and extracurricular activities alongside their academic studies at this specialized institution.

founder.name: As
founder.bio: Dr. Editha Kamara founded Lion Mountain Academy to support sixth-grade scholars. Drawing on her Sierra Leonean heritage and Doctor of Education credentials, she utilizes Socratic inquiry and economic logic to foster independent leadership through productive struggle.

schools.name: Via Forma Learning Academy
schools.description: Via Forma Learning Academy in Davenport, Florida, serves students from kindergarten through third grade. The school offers a specialized educational model that combines holistic development with evidence-based clinical instruction. Its literacy framework is strictly rooted in the Science of Reading, utilizing systematic and explicit programs to ensure mastery of language mechanics. The learning environment blends hands-on, tactile exploration characteristic of Montessori methods with structured interventions designed specifically for students with learning differences.

founder.name: With
founder.bio: Via Forma Learning Academy founder holds a Specialist in Educational Leadership and a Master’s in the Art of Teaching. With over two decades as a veteran classroom teacher and educational leader, she established the school to support students with disabilities and unique learning needs through personalized literacy instruction.

schools.name: Rhythms of Home Learning Community
schools.description: Rhythms of Home Learning Community is a nature-inspired hybrid school in Cordova, Tennessee, serving students from kindergarten through twelfth grade. Founded by an experienced educator, the program offers a flexible alternative to traditional schooling by combining structured in-person instruction on Mondays through Thursdays with independent at-home learning on Fridays. This approach prioritizes individual pacing and curiosity, allowing families to integrate rest, family time, and enrichment into the weekly schedule while maintaining academic engagement.

founder.name: Rachael
founder.bio: Rachael is a homeschooling mother of six with over a decade of experience creating hands-on learning environments. She founded Rhythms of Home Learning Community to offer a nature-based approach, prioritizing curiosity and individual exploration through balanced structure and flexibility.

schools.name: Micro School Greensboro Powered by Huntington Learning Center
schools.description: Micro School Greensboro Powered by Huntington Learning Center serves students from PreK through 8th Grade in Greensboro, North Carolina. Accredited and drawing on decades of educational experience, the school provides a state-aligned curriculum with electives. It utilizes a six-to-one student-to-teacher ratio to deliver personalized instruction via online and printed materials, offering an alternative learning model within a structured environment.

founder.name: In
founder.bio: Anne Huntington Sharma is the President and CEO of Micro School Greensboro Powered by Huntington Learning Center. She leads the organization founded in 1977 by her parents, Eileen Huntington, a former high school teacher, and Dr. Raymond Huntington, a former college professor and senior business analyst.

schools.name: Harmony and Health Microschool
schools.description: Harmony and Health Microschool in Miami serves students from kindergarten through fifth grade. Founded by a certified music teacher and a health and wellness coach, the school combines personalized online academics with artistic expression and physical well-being. Lead educator Mrs. Lambe-Estevez utilizes her background in elementary education and music to guide individualized learning paths, ensuring each student receives tailored instruction that addresses their unique strengths and academic needs within a small-class setting.

schools.name: EduPrep Academy
schools.description: EduPrep Academy serves sixth through eighth graders in Montgomery, Alabama. Founded by an educator with over fifteen years of experience, the school targets students who are passing classes but lack academic challenge or engagement. The curriculum emphasizes small-group instruction and personalized support to address individual learning gaps. By integrating real-world applications with intentional personal development, the program aims to foster confidence, communication skills, and deeper subject mastery for adolescents seeking a more connected educational environment.

founder.name: Edu
founder.bio: Jennifer Humphrey founded EduPrep Academy. She brings over 15 years of experience as a teacher, instructional coach, interventionist, and academic leader in Montgomery, Alabama schools.

schools.name: Country Grace Christian Academy
schools.description: Country Grace Christian Academy is a microschool in Canyon, Texas, serving students from Pre-K through 12th grade. The institution offers flexible educational pathways, including full-time microschool programs, hybrid learning options, and home-based academic support. Its distinct approach combines individualized instruction with small-group environments to address diverse student needs while emphasizing faith-based values and community-oriented learning structures.

founder.bio: Country Grace Christian Academy founder holds a Master of Education in Curriculum and Instruction from the University of Houston–Clear Lake, a Master of Education in Administration and Supervision from the University of Houston–Victoria, and a Bachelor of Science in Interdisciplinary Studies.

schools.name: Ingenue Preparatory Christian Academy
schools.description: Located in Tampa, Florida, Ingenue Preparatory Christian Academy serves students in grades 3rd through 8th. The school utilizes a Hybrid Mastery Model that integrates traditional academics with digital literacy and movement-based learning. Distinctive features include electives such as game design and creative writing, alongside a Harvest House System focused on mentorship and community accountability. This microschool maintains small cohort sizes to provide individualized instruction within a controlled growth framework.

founder.bio: Stefani Curington founded Ingenue Preparatory Christian Academy. A former paraeducator and teacher in Tampa, FL, she also owns an online bakery specializing in gourmet Southern desserts.

schools.name: Flight Academy
schools.description: Flight Academy in Killeen, Texas, serves students from PreK through 2nd grade with a curriculum centered on emotional well-being and social development. The school integrates mental health support as a core educational pillar rather than an ancillary service. This approach aims to foster self-driven academic success by prioritizing the psychological stability of young learners alongside traditional instructional goals.

founder.name: Throughout Erica
founder.bio: Erica founded Flight Academy after working in public schools, foster care, Child Protective Services, and the Texas Juvenile Justice Parole system. She previously established Just Me! Sport and Fitness, a youth-led organization hosting basketball tournaments, book clubs, talent shows, and entrepreneurship events.

schools.name: Canyon Preparatory Academy
schools.description: Canyon Preparatory Academy is a 100% online college preparatory program located in Litchfield Park, Arizona, serving students in grades 10th through 12th. The school offers Standard and Honors pathways, including faith-based options, for both full-time and part-time enrollment. Instruction covers core academics, sciences, humanities, and electives, alongside certificate programs, delivered by educators with specialized backgrounds in biology, medicine, psychology, and curriculum development.

founder.bio: Sharon holds advanced degrees in education, 30 years of curriculum experience, and medical certifications. Theresa possesses multiple degrees in biology, medicine, and psychology, alongside 15 years as a college educator and subject matter expert.

schools.name: The Kairos Workshop
schools.description: The Kairos Workshop is a microschool in Youngstown, Ohio, serving students in grades 6th through 9th. The curriculum emphasizes Arts, Science, and Leadership development. Instruction focuses on strengthening academic abilities through debate, writing, public speaking, artistic expression, and active scientific engagement. The program aims to cultivate communication skills, critical thinking, and confidence, encouraging students to strive toward their full potential within a collaborative educational environment.

founder.bio: Rahman Kevin Smith founded The Kairos Workshop. He spent twenty years teaching at Shenzhen University and serving as Director of the Self-Access Language Learning Center at The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen, while founding debate programs and writing curriculum.

schools.name: Prestige Wisdom Academy
schools.description: Prestige Wisdom Academy is a microschool in Houston, Texas, serving students from PreK through 12th grade. The institution specializes in personalized instruction for diverse learners, including those requiring special education support. By utilizing small class sizes and individualized teaching methods, the school integrates traditional academics with innovative enrichment programs and life skills development to foster academic excellence and character growth within a flexible educational framework.

founder.name: Temitayo Moses
founder.bio: Temitayo Moses founded Prestige Wisdom Academy in Houston, Texas. She holds an NCE from Saint Andrews College of Education (1994), a B.Ed. from the University of Ado Ekiti (2004), and an M.Ed. from Bowie State University (2014). She is a certified teacher in Maryland, West Virginia, and Texas.

schools.name: Inheritance Hall
schools.description: Inheritance Hall is a K–8 microschool located in San Antonio, Texas. Founded on biblical principles, the institution integrates faith into every subject to provide personalized academic excellence. The curriculum emphasizes spiritual growth, creativity, and collaborative learning across grade levels. Students explore real-life challenges within a nurturing environment designed to help them discover their purpose while developing confidence in their identity through a Christ-centered educational framework.

founder.bio: Destiny founded Inheritance Hall. A San Antonio native, she is a mother, minister, and mentor with experience in homeschooling, after-school programs, daycares, and youth ministry.

schools.name: Growing Up Holistic
schools.description: Growing Up Holistic is a microschool in New Market, Tennessee, serving students from first through eighth grade. The institution utilizes the Charlotte Mason educational approach, emphasizing living books, daily outdoor time, and hands-on projects. Core academics are taught without homework assignments. Students develop critical thinking and communication skills through portfolios, presentations, and collaborative peer interactions within a structured yet flexible learning environment.

founder.bio: Charity Shultz founded Growing Up Holistic in Morristown. A second-generation homeschooling mother of eleven with a Charlotte Mason educational background, she transitioned from public schooling her children back to establishing this microschool.

schools.name: Lionsgate Academy
schools.description: Lionsgate Academy serves students in grades one through nine within Aiken County, South Carolina. The institution distinguishes itself by offering personalized learning experiences tailored to individual student needs rather than utilizing a standardized curriculum. This approach emphasizes critical thinking and problem-solving skills alongside academic instruction. Additionally, the school integrates faith-based values into its educational framework while maintaining respect for diverse beliefs and perspectives among its student body.

founder.name: Barbara Hancock
founder.bio: Barbara Hancock founded Lionsgate Academy. She holds double Bachelor’s degrees in Education and Music, plus a Master’s from the University of South Carolina. With over 22 years of public and private school experience, she focuses on underserved students.

schools.name: Bridges Microschool
schools.description: Bridges Microschool in Granger, Indiana, serves students in grades K through 6th grade. This hybrid institution utilizes a multi-age setting to provide individualized instruction and strong academics within small class sizes. The curriculum emphasizes literacy, math, project-based learning, creativity, movement, and real-world experiences. By focusing on hands-on activities and personalized support, the school aims to help students develop confidence, independence, and lifelong success habits in a relationship-centered environment.

founder.name: Amy Zache
